english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a solid object coming apart into sharp fragments, especially wood.
Use this when something physically splits or cracks open, including wood splitting along its grain.
Use this when something such as a wound or crack has split open and leaves a visible gap.
Use 裂開 when something develops a crack or splits apart under stress.

examples.english: The wooden board began to splinter under the weight of the heavy object.
The wooden board split along the grain.
examples.traditional: 塊木板沿住木紋裂開咗。
